WITH g AS (
  SELECT m.link_to_major AS link_to_major, j.college AS college, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM member m JOIN major j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major
  GROUP BY m.link_to_major, j.college
),
t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g),
s AS (
  SELECT g.link_to_major, g.college, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share
  FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
),
c AS (
  SELECT college, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s GROUP BY college
)
SELECT s.link_to_major, s.college, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - c.avg_share AS diff
FROM s JOIN c ON c.college = s.college
WHERE s.share > c.avg_share
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
